G49 written in notes-D3.md before any A17 line was read (after G48's readings): A17's fields quoted (10 segments checked against A17's record by d3_a17_g49_quote_check.py, all found); four readings from the arrow's words: the first end is the room's attack, read as G48 reads it, with a visitor's call apart; the second end is talk of terms between the room and another room as G18 reads P08, from either room's record, so a neighbour's offer or request counts, while restraint that names no terms (P07), help traded for help (P16), an alliance (P17), taunts (P18), a proposal to ask with no request made and a lone placer's talk do not; the census records whether the talk answers the attack in the thread or by the hours; and it marks each answer in the thread as invoking terms already made (INV), proposing or settling new terms (DEAL) or another form of P08 (OTHER). G48's heads 1 to 3 and 6 apply with P08 in place of P07; its heads 4 and 5 do not, and the target's reply is not set apart, since terms are talk between two rooms. The bound's early and late sides cannot be read from the lines, so the census reports the bound's pattern by room. G49's readings 1 to 9, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i432_000 (26 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (1) A call to fight back or retaliate against another room is the room's attack, as G48's rulings read AyyMD-046 and maryland-054 (2007scape-064, c1131; DestinyTheGame-042, c0164, whose reply says the neighbour was there first); retaking the room's own work is defence and not the room's attack, by G48's head 2 (NewMexico-058, c0051, NA). (2) An alliance with the target, named as standing between the two rooms and invoked against the attack, is terms held, G18's report that such terms exist (PinkUnion-024 c0050; AprilKnights-059 c0046 with its pact); friendship that names no agreement is restraint with no terms, NT (argentina-061 c0183). (3) A member's proposal to the room to compromise or settle with a neighbour, with no request made to that neighbour, is not talk of terms between the rooms, by G18's readings on proposals to ask and choices inside the room (DestinyTheGame-042 c0167; PlaceNL-059 c0127, accepted inside the room by c0129): NT. (4) A call whose writer addresses the room from outside, or invites it into an outside front, is a visitor's; answered by terms it is V (AprilKnights-059 c0045; EraseThePlace-050 c0283, a submission to the Erasers asking them to realign their motives). (5) Terms before the first coded act of the room's is the bound's pattern (AmericanFlaginPlace-068: c0173 holds the room to a truce at h+39.00 in a thread on another room's spread; c0183 first reports the room's own spread at h+40.41). (6) A post that calls an attack by setting agreements aside is an attack and talk of terms (G18's ending the agreement) in one post: J (TheB1G-047 c0029). (7) A threat inside terms, to cover the other room only if it breaks them, is part of the terms and not a separate attack; with the attack proposal in a post with no code, only terms are shown: ONE (PinkVomitMonster-056 c0072; bakchodi-026 c0210 also ONE). (8) Forms: INV where terms already made are invoked toward the target, including a member told to stop violating the room's treaty (TheFarLeftSide-050 c0428); DEAL where new terms are offered, asked or settled, including the target's offer (Thegreatblackhole-026 c0076) and a demand to use diplomatic channels followed by a reported settlement (austria-029 c0116, c0120); OTHER where the answer reports terms with a third room (berkeley-048 c0028, space granted by Sweden), contests or refuses terms, or complains of the other room's breach. (9) An edit inside the attacking post that reports peace being made shows the order in the post's words, O-H, even where a reply in the thread then invokes the treaty (GuardiansOfDatBoi-019 c0021, c0023). Draws in this window: argentina-061 NT, PlaceNL-059 NT, austria-029 O-A.
